paper_title: Search for Axion-Like Particles produced in $e^+e^-$ collisions at Belle II
notes: Belle II search for e+e->gamma a, a->gamma gamma. Sets 95% CL upper limits on g_agamma at the level of 10^-3 GeV^-1 for ALP masses 0.2 < m_a < 9.7 GeV. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton. Exact numerical values are provided in supplemental text file (not in the paper text), so the data points here are approximate, reflecting the stated ~10^-3 GeV^-1 level across the mass range.
